entries.text: When you load a file and keep your board positions, sims new to your board now fit in beside their family or world instead of landing on top of other households.
Importing a save no longer piles households and worlds on top of each other. Sims who join a family already on the board sit with that family, and anything below moves down to make room.
New Hide secrets filter: take secret lovers and secret parents off the board for spoiler-free screenshots. Nothing moves, and they come back when you turn it off.

Importing a save now shows secret lovers (a heart with a lock) and secret parents (a lock on the child's line), and tapping the line of parents who aren't a couple shows what they are to each other, like best friends.
Moving a sim on a big board is quicker: only the links near it are redrawn, not every link on the board.
Every child's line now reaches its parents. Lines no longer stop in mid-air when the parents aren't partners or when siblings sit to one side.
Big boards pan and zoom more smoothly: only the part around your view is drawn, and it keeps up as you move.
When you load a file and keep your board positions, your view stays where it was too.
Replace can now keep your board's positions, and merging a file brings its filters along. The dialog tells you first, and Undo puts yours back.
When you merge a JSON file, cards no longer jump around: they stay where they are, or go exactly where the file shows them.
Opening a filter panel now dims the board and moves the worlds list out of the way. Tap outside the panel to close it.
Quick tips is tidier and only opens when you ask for it, and filter panels slide up from the bottom on tablets and small laptops too.
Connect now refuses a link that would make a sim their own ancestor, and tells you why.
Fix the board freezing when two sims are linked as each other's parent.
Make big boards, like imported saves, rearrange about twice as fast after an edit.
Fix sims jumping back to where they started after you drag them.
When you merge a JSON file, you can now keep the card positions on this board or use the ones in the file.
Hide the changelog's own housekeeping entries.
Log the tooltip fix and the plain-language rewrite.
Rewrite this list in plain language, and drop the entries that only mean something to a programmer.
Stop the hover labels on the top bar running off the edge of the window.
Log the Developer updates panel in its own changelog.
Add this Developer updates list to the ⋮ menu, so you can see what has changed.
Worlds now stay where you drop them, including on top of each other.
Open the board faster by not drawing card names while you are zoomed too far out to read them.
Make the board appear sooner when you open the site.
Start counting which features get used, so the busiest ones get the most attention.
You can now click the shared line above a group of brothers and sisters, not only the branch down to each one.
Remove the Export PNG option from the ⋮ menu.
Keep relationship labels sitting on the line they describe, straighten family branches, and make saving and loading more reliable.
entries.compat: Saved files now record which version of the board made them. From here on, loading a file the board cannot lay out correctly tells you so and tidies it up, instead of quietly putting cards in the wrong places. Files saved before today have no such marker, so they always get re-arranged.

entries.text: Add importing a Sims 4 save file, add the little map in the corner, and stop worlds landing on top of each other.
entries.compat: Older .json files stop working properly here. This update moved every card onto a tile grid, so a board saved before today no longer lines up and will be re-arranged when you load it. Your sims, households and links all survive — only where you dragged things is lost.

entries.text: Your Filters choices are now saved with the board, so loading it back shows the same view.
Add gender to the sim editor, and pick one at random for new sims.
Reorganise the top bar so related buttons sit together and every filter shares one menu.
Add Age up for a whole household, add Undo, add Bloodline to dim everyone outside one family, and record all of it in the Log.
Add an infant straight from a couple, stop menus opening off the edge of the screen, and make the Log easier to read.
Add the Log of every link you make, and stop cards jumping about when you link sims or move a household.
Add a contact email to the ⋮ menu.
Correct the family links in the Other world against The Sims Wiki.
Make the board work properly on phones, with pinch to zoom and drag to pan, and drop new sims where you are looking.
Install Vercel Web Analytics.
Update repo and production URLs after GitHub rename.
Add the Credits panel, the project licence, and the Family Trees name.
Stop relationship lines running across cards they have nothing to do with.
Lay the Other world out in neat columns and keep related households side by side.
Arrange each household automatically, so parents sit above their children.
Stop the line to a child doubling back on itself when they sit just below their parents.
Collapse the header and toolbar into a single bar across the top.
Stop relationship lines taking long detours around cards.
Stop the board re-centring itself while you are dragging.
Make relationship lines meet cards from the side, so they are easier to follow.
Bring back the missing relationship symbols, and clear the line that stuck to the cursor after linking.
Fix the board not fitting the window when it opens, and tidy where the legend and the how-to note sit.
Fix the board not filling the whole window.
Fix Vercel build: pin Node 22 and configure pnpm install via corepack.
First version of the Family Trees Whiteboard.
